propositions: bedrock_region_name resolved from repo config ([llm] table in rebar.toml) is mislabeled as region_source=REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION instead of region_source=repo-config in provider provenance records
LLMConfig.from_env collapses CLI/env/config-file resolution into a single string via _llm_str, discarding the resolved value's origin
region_source labeling must be derived from the same resolution pass that produced the value and carried on LLMConfig as bedrock_region_source to prevent record/runtime divergence
region resolution precedence must remain unchanged (CLI > env > config-file > default, then AWS_DEFAULT_REGION > AWS_REGION) with accurate per-source labels
config-resolved regions must record region_source=repo-config, CLI-resolved as cli, and env vars as REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION/AWS_DEFAULT_REGION/AWS_REGION
pure in-process labeling with no CI-provider-specific hooks is required for portability
